HediffDef.label: adhesion savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has drawn on Adhesion so deeply that the Surge of pressure and vacuum has become woven into {PAWN_possessive} spirit web. {PAWN_pronoun} instinctively manipulates the bonds between things, but {PAWN_pronoun} grows restless without the constant flow of Stormlight.

HediffDef.label: gravitation savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has lashed so relentlessly that gravity itself bends to {PAWN_possessive} will without conscious thought. {PAWN_possessive} sense of direction is permanently altered - up and down are merely suggestions - but without Stormlight, {PAWN_pronoun} feels impossibly heavy.

HediffDef.label: division savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has channeled Division until the capacity to destroy and degrade matter has scarred {PAWN_possessive} spirit web. {PAWN_pronoun} perceives the inherent entropy in all things, but without Stormlight to contain it, that destructive awareness turns inward.

HediffDef.label: abrasion savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has slicked surfaces so frequently that friction has become almost foreign to {PAWN_objectPronoun}. {PAWN_pronoun} moves with an unsettling fluidity, but {PAWN_possessive} grip on the world - physical and metaphorical - grows tenuous without Stormlight.

HediffDef.label: progression savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has drawn on Progression so extensively that growth and healing have become extensions of {PAWN_possessive} will. Life responds to {PAWN_possessive} touch, but without the surge of Stormlight, {PAWN_possessive} own body feels stagnant and unnatural.

HediffDef.label: illumination savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has bent light and sound so often that illusions flicker at the edges of {PAWN_possessive} vision even when {PAWN_pronoun} is not actively weaving. The line between the real and the fabricated has grown thin for {PAWN_objectPronoun}.

HediffDef.label: transformation savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has Soulcast so relentlessly that {PAWN_possessive} perception of matter itself has shifted. {PAWN_pronoun} instinctively senses the nature of objects and the Cognitive aspect of things, but the constant weight of transformation has reshaped {PAWN_possessive} spirit web in ways not entirely comfortable.

HediffDef.label: transportation savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has Elsecalled so frequently that the boundary between realms has worn thin in {PAWN_possessive} perception. {PAWN_pronoun} exists half in this world and half beyond it, and without Stormlight, the pull toward the Cognitive Realm grows disconcerting.

HediffDef.label: cohesion savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has shaped stone and solid matter so many times that {PAWN_possessive} hands remember the work without {PAWN_possessive} mind directing them. Stone responds to {PAWN_possessive} touch with unnatural ease, but without the surge of Stormlight, even simple materials feel resistant and alien.

HediffDef.label: tension savant
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has hardened surfaces and reinforced materials so extensively that rigidity has become {PAWN_possessive} natural state. {PAWN_possessive} movements carry an unsettling solidity, and without Stormlight flowing through {PAWN_objectPronoun}, {PAWN_pronoun} feels brittle rather than strong.
